overflow.label: When columns don't fit
overflow.fitHelp: All columns on one page width; the font shrinks automatically if needed.
overflow.splitHelp: Columns that don't fit continue on the next pages; key columns such as Appraisal No. repeat where the report has them.

fontSize.label: Font size
fontSize.fitHelp: With "Fit to page width", this is the maximum size: the table shrinks automatically (down to {{min}} px) if the columns don't fit. The title, filters and sign-offs use this size.
